comment: * Listener interface for notifications that an app's idle state changed.

methods.name: public abstract void onAppIdleStateChanged(String packageName, @UserIdInt int userId, boolean idle, int bucket, int reason)
methods.comment: Callback to inform listeners that the idle state has changed to a new bucket.

methods.name: public void onParoleStateChanged(boolean isParoleOn)
methods.comment:
* Callback to inform listeners that the parole state has changed. This means apps are
         * allowed to do work even if they're idle or in a low bucket.

methods.name: public void onUserInteractionStarted(String packageName, @UserIdInt int userId)
methods.comment:
* Optional callback to inform the listener that the app has transitioned into
         * an active state due to user interaction.

methods.comment: * Optional callback to inform the listener to give the app a temporary quota bump.
